narrative_purpose: A low-contrast full-bleed ocean mood layer suggests a society moving through enormous dark water without competing with the chapter text.
subject: A distant pod of immense tulkun silhouettes traveling beneath a vast dark ocean surface, their four-eyed heads and multiple flippers only faintly legible, with one separated silhouette following farther behind. Sparse bioluminescent plankton and a dim reef shelf dissolve into haze. No close subject and no bright focal point.
scene: Pandora's open ocean at deep night seen from a very high, distant vantage, water extending beyond sight in every direction.
camera: Ultra-wide panoramic view from high above and behind the pod, extremely distant scale and layered atmospheric depth.
light: Very dim indigo ambience, faint living-teal traces along the pod and almost imperceptible cyan plankton, uniformly low contrast for readable overlaid text.
palette: Nearly all void indigo and deep ocean teal, minimal muted cyan, no warm focal accents.
style: Painterly atmospheric ocean vista, hand-painted and immersive, designed as a background rather than a study plate.
detail_level: Soft silhouettes and dissolving reef depth; intentionally little local contrast or sharp detail.
composition: Pod occupies a small lower-third diagonal, one separated animal trails behind, upper two-thirds remain dark open water with even tone.
consistency_notes: Same tulkun body language as the cover but rendered only as distant low-contrast silhouettes. Preserve a dark reading surface above all else.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no labels, no bright focal subject, no lens flare, no photographic or CGI look, no ordinary two-eyed Earth whales, no cartoon style
